properties.name: Szuhajdomb
properties.approximationNote: Szuhay-domb: municipal ITS explicitly describes the circuit Ivanich Antal–Dózsa György–Berzsenyi–Szigeterdő–Gyenis Antal streets. The actual modern Ivanich/Dózsa/Berzsenyi linework and Szigeterdő park approach guide this reconstruction south of Dózsa. Municipal street-renaming records establish that former Gyenis was split into Földvár and Vasút sor in 2013; the modern southern approach is used with coarse park-edge connections. No place-point location is invented. Existing OSM-named Szuhajdomb has only a small street-cell estimate NORTH of Dózsa; this source-defined planning extent should be reviewed as a canonicalization/alternative-boundary candidate rather than assumed to be an unrelated second whole quarter. Exact KSH map alignment remains unverified.

identityCorrection.reason: Municipal ITS boundary circuit, later traffic/nature-plan spellings and street-renaming records identify one historical southern-city place with j/y spelling and source-scope variants. Prefer the explicitly source-defined whole planning-unit estimate while retaining the older partial street-cell as an alternative; no geometry union.
